title: Stability and maximal regularity of the diffusion equation on unbounded surfaces
summary: This paper studies both stability and maximal regularity of the diffusion equation on an unbounded surface without any assumptions on the curvature. We show that the surface diffusion system admits a unique global-in-time strong solution satisfying $L^2$-asymptotic stability when the slope of the surface is gentle. We also derive maximal $L^2$-regularity of the solution when the exterior force satisfies both surface divergence form and tangential condition.
